title: Regex tester: test JavaScript regular expressions online
description: Test a JavaScript regular expression against your text: matches are highlighted, capture groups (named ones too) are listed, and the g, i, m, s, u, y flags are one click away. Includes replace with $1 and $<name>.

flags.m: multiline: ^ and $ match at line breaks
